title: Whipped Cheesecake Yogurt Berry Parfait
hookLine: Tastes like strawberry cheesecake in a jar—whipped Greek yogurt, lemon zest, berries & toasted granola.

items.name: Greek yogurt + 1 tsp vanilla + lemon zest

steps.title: Line Pan & Prep Base Ingredients
steps.instructionTemplate: Line a loaf pan, baking dish, or serving glasses with parchment paper or chill them in the fridge for 5 minutes. Measure out {yp_yog} and {yp_grn} so your base whips up thick, creamy, and clump-free.

steps.title: Whip Yogurt Cheesecake Smooth & Layer
steps.instructionTemplate: Whisk {yp_yog} until airy, then layer in glasses with {yp_ber} and {yp_grn}. Chill or freeze until completely firm and set, then portion into 2 servings and store leftovers in an airtight container.
steps.creatorSecret: Chill Whipped Cheesecake Yogurt Berry Parfait until completely firm before portioning, and wipe your knife with a warm damp cloth between cuts for bakery-sharp edges.

steps.title: Transfer, Smooth Top & Add Garnish
steps.instructionTemplate: Pour or press the mixture evenly into your prepared dish, smoothing the surface with a spatula. Scatter {yp_ber} evenly across the top and press gently so it adheres cleanly.

steps.title: Chill Until Firm, Slice & Store
steps.instructionTemplate: Cover and refrigerate Whipped Cheesecake Yogurt Berry Parfait until completely firm and sliceable. Portion into 2 servings, add any crisp toppings right before serving, and keep leftovers chilled in an airtight container for up to 5 days.

ugcQuotes.quote: Zero refined sugar and only 185 cal—tastes like total indulgence!
